integrity: The all-parameter theorem is supported by an explicit transfer-matrix and Burnside proof. A standard-library Python checker exhaustively compares fixed-point counts and orbit decompositions for n=5,...,9 and does not replace that proof. An inaccessible historical full text remains a priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Only complete nonalgebraic unary types over crowns with n>=5 are classified up to automorphisms of the finite base. The Lucas ideal total and named one-type total are established earlier results; the new result is the full dihedral fixed-point character and orbit number. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: An equivariant Fibonacci–Lucas law for crown-poset one-point extensions
